tei:div.tei:p: (347)rgyud dbang rdo rje'i phreng ba bzhugs so: (348)

bla ma dang gnyis su med 'i mgon po 'jam dpal dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo mchod do/ skyabs su mchi'o byin gyis rlabs par mjod du gsol: ye shes sku rnams ma lus 'chang*/ rgyud kun gyi ni bdag po mchog 'jam dpal dpal dang ldan pa'i mchog mchog sbyin rdo rje mchog khyod 'dud/ de la 'jam dpal skud lugs zhi ba'i sgrub thabs kyi smin byed dbang bskur sbyin pa la/ 'khor lo'i steng du mañju'i khar dbus su bum pa/ mdun du tsal+li/ g.yas su gsang rdzas thod chang dang rgyud kyi glegs bam/ g.yon tu rig tsa dang phyag mtshan/ rgyab tu lan shes me long sgro mdangs gyi brgyan pa bzhag mtha' bskor du thun mong rig pa'i dbang lnga'i rdzas kyang legs par bkod/ gzhan yang mchod pa'i yo byad bya nom sa dang mar me brgya rtsas bskor la byin ldan du bsgrub la/ de nas slob ma khrus byas/ bgegs bskrad/ srung 'khor bsgom/ de nas blo bcos zhing lo rgyus bshad/ maṇ+ḍal phul la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ kye/ khyab bdag bdag la sman pa dang*/ bdag don bdag la thugs brtse'i phyir/ sgyu 'phrul drwa ba mngon rdzogs pa'i/ byang chub ci nas bdag thob mjod/ lan gsum/ de nas lan bshad pa ni/ (349)e ma/ thog ma bar dang mthar dge ba/ 'das pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsungs/ ma 'ongs rnams kyi gsungs gyur la/ da ltar byung ba'i rdzogs sangs rgyas/ yang dang yang du gsang ba gang*/ rgyu chen sgyu 'phrul drwa ba las/ rdo rje'i dbang bskur sbyin par bya'o/ de nas oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis mimag dar bcing*/ a khaṃ wi ra hūm̐ gis me tog sbyin/ de nas mna' chu sbyin pa ni/ nang mchod bdud rtsi'i chu lce thog bzhag la khe nyan legs par bshad la/ hūm̐: dam tshig chen po sngags kyi chu/ rdo rje sems dpa' sems dpa' che/ rdo rje rgyal po bde ba che/ rdo rje snying po snying la bzhag khyod kyi bsam pa brtan pos zungs/ sa ma ya e dun na ra kan/ de nas skyabs su 'gro ba ni/

rjogs pa'i sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das/ 'gro ba'i bla ma ston pa po/ 'jigs pa ma lus sel ba la/ skyabs kyi dam par skyabs su 'os/ lan gsum/ de nas sems bskyed pa ni/ nyon mongs pas ni (350)sems dkrugs shing*/ mi shes 'dam du bying ba yi/ sems can kun la phan pa dang*/ bla med 'bras bu thob par bya/ lan gsum/ de nas snyoms sbyin pa ni/ hoḥ tshogs kyi slob dpon tshogs kyi mchog tshogs rje tshogs bdag bdag la dgongs/ mgon po rdzogs sangs rgyas kun gyi/ gsang 'jin ci nas bdag 'gyur phyir/ rigs gsum 'chang ba gsang sngags can/ dam tshig chen po gsang sngags sdom/ nges par 'byung gi bar du ni/ bdag gi bsam pa brtan pos gzungs/ lan gsum/ de nas slob ma ltar gsal la/ hūm̐: 'phags mchog thugs rjes dus la bab/ sogs/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhiḥ e a ral+li pheṃ jaḥ hūm̐ ha a dzheṃḥ badz+ra dz+nyā na a be sha ya hūm̐ hūm̐: zhes byin dbab bo/ de nas dngos grub kyi sra ltas brtan pa ni/ hoḥ dpal ldan 'jam dpal dkyil 'khor du/ byang chub yan lag me tog 'dor/ bzang ngan shes shing dus shes la/ dus shes sems can dbang po shes/ (351)badz+ra puṣ+pe pra ti tsa hoḥ zhes 'jam dpal rigs lnga'i dkyil 'khor du 'dor la/ rang rig dang mthun pa'i mi rdo rje'i mi dbang skabs su btags/ de nas mig phyes pa ni/ hoḥ rdo rje rnon po ral gri ches/ nyon mongs mi shes g.yul ngo sel/ ye shes mig gcig dri ma med/ spyan lnga chags pa med par 'chang*/ 'gro kun dga' ba'i mig ldan shog badz+ra tsak+ṣu pra be sha ya phaṭa/ de nas dbang bskur ba la gnyis las/ dang po thun mong rigs pa'i dbang lnga bskur ba ni/ las bum thogs te/ so so rang rig mi g.yo ba/ mchog gi dang po sku gsung 'chang*/ khyab bdag ye shes lnga yi bdag mi bskyod rigs kyi bdag po'i dbang*/ oṃ ma hā shu bya tā dz+nyā na a bhi ṣañca maṃ/ de nas dbu rgyan thogs la/ sangs rgyas lnga bdag cod pan can/

spyan lnga chags pa med par 'chang*/ ye shes dbang bskur cod pan can/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rgyan du thogs/ oṃ ma hā sa ma tā dz+nyā na/ de nas rdo rje thogs la/ sangs rgyas thams cad skyed (352)pa po/ sangs rgyas sras po dam pa'i mchog chos las 'byung ba srid pa sel/ gcig pu pra mkhreg rdo rje'i bdag rdo rje phreng thog dpal dang ldan/ oṃ ma hā pra t+ya bek+ṣa na dz+nyā na/ dril bu thogs te/ don grub bsam pa grub pa ste/ kun tu rtog pa thams cad spangs/ shes rab mtshon chas rnam 'joms pa/ don yod zhags pa rnam par rgyal/ oṃ ma ha kṛ t+ya nuṣ+ṭha ṇa dz+nyā a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ de nas gsang ba'i ming btags la/ chos dbyings dam pa zad mi shes/ ye shes ye shes 'byung gnas che/ ye shes ldan pa yod mi shes/ ming yang che zhing rgya che ba/ dkyil 'khor chen po yangs pa yin/ oṃ ma hā a dar+sha dz+nyā na a bhi ṣiñca māṃ/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi dbang bskur ba ni/ dang po bum pa'i dbang ni/ dhīḥ bum pa bzang pa che ba'i mchog chos shes bkra shis bkra shis 'byung*/ bkra shis kun gyi bkra shis pa/ grags pa bkra shis snyan grags dge dbugs 'byin chen por dbang bskur ro/ (353)oṃ ka la sha a bhi ṣiñca maṃ/ rjes 'brel sku'i dbang ni/ yab kyi sku thogs te/ dhīḥ ye shes sku te rang byung ba/ 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa' che/ tshig gi dbang phyug smra ba che/ smra ba'i skyes mchog smra ba'i rgyal/ smra ba'i dam pa mchog gi gnas/ smra ba'i seng ge tshugs pa med/ rdo rje rin chen dbang bskur bas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sprul pa'i sku/ bye ba dpag med 'gyed par shog oṃ mañju shrī dz+nyā na sa twa hūm̐ ka ya a bhi ṣiñca oṃ/ dbyangs can ma'i sku thogs la/ hrīḥ bdag med seng ge'i sgra dang ldan/ mu stegs ri dwags ngan 'jigs byed/ tshig rje tshig bdag smra mkhas ldan/ tshig la dbang ba tshig mtha' yas/ dbyangs can yum gyi dbang bskur bas/

grub pa mthar phyin 'khrul ba med/ nor ba thams cad rnam par spangs/ don gsum the tshom med pa'i blo/ rdo rje blo gros don rig shog oṃ mañju shrī āḥ (354)wā gi shwa ri mūṃḥ dharma dha tu saṅga daḥ dz+nyā na gar+bha a hrīḥ a i e o aṃ aḥ ra li la li ye hūm̐ hrīḥ ka ya a bhi ṣiñca mūm̐/ de nas gsang dbang ni/ dhīḥ gsang sngags don kun bskyed pa'i rdzas/ thig le chen po yi ge med/ stong pa chen po yi ge lnga/ thig le stong pa yi ge brgya/ rnam pa kun ldan rnam pa med/ bcu drug phyed phyed thig le can/ rdo rje rtsemo rab 'phro ba/ gsang sngags chen po'i dbang bskur bas/ yan lag med pa'i rtsis las 'das/ bsam gtan bzhi pa'i rtse mo can/ bsam gtan yan lag kun shes shing*/ ting 'jin rig dang rgyud rig pa/ ting 'jin lus can lus kyi mchacog longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku thob shog rtsa sngags dang*/ bho dhi tsirta a bhi ṣiñca māṃḥ rjes 'brel po ti gtad la/ dhīḥ yi ge drug pa rdo rje sgra/ 'jam dbyangs chen po sgra che ba/ nam mkha'i mtha' klas sgra sgrogs pa/ klu blang gang lags dbang (355)bskur bas/ stong nyid smra ba'i khyu mchog ste/ zab cing rgya che'i sgra sgrogs pa/ chos kyi dung sta sgra chen ldan/ chos kyi gaṇ+ḍe sgra bo che/ tshugs pa med cing cher bsgrags shog rtsa sngags dang*/ wak+ka a bhi ṣiñca āḥ de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ni/ dhīḥ dag pa rnam pa bcu gnyis 'chang*/ de nyid rnam pa bcu drug rig rnam pa nyi shus byang chub pa/ gzugs med gzugs bzang dam pa ste/ sna tshogs gzugs can dbang bskur bas/ nyon mongs khams rnams dag pa'i bdag las kyi khams rnams zad byed pa/ chu bo rgya mtsho kun las brgal/ sbyor ba'i dgon pa las byung ba/ nyon mongs nye ba'i kun nyon mongs/ bag chags bcas pa gtan spangs nas/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes mtsho/ mkha' ltar mnyam pa nyid gnas shog rtsa sngags dang*/

dharmā dhā tu dz+nyā na a bhī ṣiñca hūm̐/ rjes 'brel phyag mtshan gyi dbang ni/ hūm̐: (356)byams pa'i go cha chas pa ste/ snying rje yi ni ya lad bgos/ shes rab ral gri mda' gzhu thogs/ nyon mongs mi shes g.yul ngo sel/ dpa' bo bdud dgra bdud 'dul ba/ bdud bzhi'i 'jigs pa sel bar byed/ bdud kyi dpung rnams pham byed pa/ theg pa chen po sdug bsngal gcod/ rdo rje mtshon chas dbang bskur bas/ sa bcu la ni gnas pa dang*/ rgyal ba dgra rgya rnam par rgyal/ thub dbang stobs bcu khyab pa'i bdag tshangs par spyod pa brtul zhugs kyis/ sems can kun yid tshim par byed/ sems can kun yid dga' bar shog rtsa sngags dang*/ tsirta a bhi ṣiñca a a āḥ bzhi pa tshig dbang ni/ don rig stong gdod ma'i 'jam mgon ye shes sems dpa' 'am gzhi dang lam dang 'bras bu gsum gyi sgo nas ngo zhib du sprad/ mi sel dang me long thogs la/ dpon slob gnyis ka'i mnyam par bzhag la/ dhīḥ.a a aḥ kun shes kun rig dam pa po/ rnam par shes pa'i chos nyid 'das/ ye shes gnyis med (357)tshul 'chang ba/ rnam par rtog med lhun gyis grub/ a a a zhes dgongs pa'i drod gtar/ de nas rig pa rtsal gyi dbang ni rnang srid dag mnyam tshen po 'jam dpal ye shes sems dpa'i gsang gsum lhun grub rin po che'i sbubs zhing khams sgron ma bzhi'i gnad bstan la sku dang ye shes su yid ches par bshad te/ dhīḥ nam mkha' las byung rang byung ba/ shes rab ye shes me bo che/ 'od chen rnam par snang bar byed/ ye shes snang ba lam me ba/ 'gro ba'i mar me ye shes sgron/ gzi brjid cen po 'od gsal ba/ sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs che ba/ sangs rgyas kun gyi thugs la gnas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku che ba/ sangs rgyas kun gyi gsung yang yin/ rdo rje nyi ma snang ba che/ rdo rje zla ba dri med 'od/ gom pa'i stabs kyis gar mjod cig ces gnad gsum chos nyid kyi 'khor lo zhib tu bshad la bslab bo/

de nas dbugs dbyung ba ni/ rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten 'dren/ mchod 'os bstod 'os phyag gi gnas/ rtag tu ri mor (358)bya ba'i 'os/ bskur 'os rjed par bya ba'i mchog phyag byar 'os pa bla ma'i rab/ dus 'di nyid nas khyed kyis thob/ mjug tu dam tshig khas blang ba ni/ rtsa ba saku gsung thugs mchog dang*/ yan lag dam tshig nyi shu lnga/ med phyal gcig su lhun gyis grub/ dam tshig rnams ni legs par gzungs/ lan gsum brjod do/ e ma rab zab gsang chen rgyud kyi dbang*/ 'di ni sngon chad rgyud du gnas med kyang*/ gnas ji bzhin mngon du byung ba med/ gang dang mi 'dra kun las khyad par 'phags/ skal ldan skye bo'i tshogs rnams dga' bar mjod/ 'di ni lha dang bla ma'i byin rlabs gnyis/ rang bzhin yid la legs par shar ba'i mthus/ 'bum phrag mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo mtsho rgyal gyis/ byin rlabs dbang bskur lung bstan dbyugs dbyung bas/ deng sang 'di na shin tu gsal bar byas/ 'dir 'bad dge bas khams gsum 'gro ba rnams/ 'jam dpal dpa' bo bcaum ldan bde bar gshegs/ sangs rgyas ye shes rgya mtshor dbang bskur nas/ mjad pa ngo mtshar rmad byung bsam yas pa/ 'gro ba'i 'dren par chis pa mthong (359)(360) gyur cig ces pa 'di ni gter sras kun bzang gis yang yang bskul ngor 'jam dpal rdo rje'i byin rlabs kyi snang ba snying la thob cing*/ thos pa dang*/ bsam pa dang*/ sgom pa'i shes rab kyi lus rgyas pa bde bar gshegs pa'i bka' rab 'byams la mang du thos pa'i rnal 'byor pa zil gnon ngag gi dbang pos/ dbyings kyi ḍāk+ki'i gsung bzhin chog khrigs ma nor bar bris pa'o/ dge'o/// /
